The Black River
A hexcrawl featuring
The Black River charges through the vast jungles 
of Tal-Yool, supplying the rainforest with its 
lifeblood. The scattered and fallen Itzalca people 
cluster along its shore in their villages and strive 
to remember their ancient purpose. Basilisk 
cultists cling to their brutal traditions, while 
archaeologists unearth that which was better 
left buried. Meanwhile, a dark and alien terror 
waits for the sun to dim. Like the night itself, the 
Black River rushes on, endless and inevitable.
